name: Lake Erie College
tuition_note: Private institution, single published rate. 2026-27 tuition & fees from lec.edu/tuition-and-fees: annual tuition $37,800 + general fees $1,000/semester ($2,000/yr) = $39,800 tuition & fees. Housing room only: standard double in Andrews/Fowler/Ritter Halls $2,970/semester = $5,940/year (excludes required meal plan). Source: https://www.lec.edu/tuition-and-fees
